name: bingetube
description: Find and get recommendations for short drama series on BingeTube, and open them on binge.tube to watch in your browser.

interface.longDescription:
BingeTube helps you find short drama series to watch. Short dramas are vertical series told in 1–2 minute episodes: billionaire romance, revenge, mafia, werewolf and fantasy, hidden identities and more.

Ask in your own words and BingeTube can:
- Search its catalog of 2,000+ series by title or by words from the story
- Recommend series for a mood, trope or story you like, such as "revenge after divorce" or "werewolf romance"
- Tell you about one series: what it's about, its genres and how many episodes it has
- Show what viewers are watching most right now, overall or for one genre

Every answer links straight to the series on binge.tube, so you can start watching in any web browser, with no app to install.

The app only reads BingeTube's public catalog. It needs no sign-in and doesn't change anything.
defaultPrompt: Find me a short drama about a mafia billionaire on BingeTube.
Recommend some werewolf romance short dramas on BingeTube.
What are the most watched short dramas on BingeTube right now?

review.commerce_description: BingeTube does not sell anything or take payments in ChatGPT. Its tools only search and describe the public catalog and link to binge.tube.

positive.prompt: Find me a short drama about a mafia billionaire on BingeTube.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_shows with a query like "mafia billionaire" and lists matching series, each with a one-line premise, its episode count and a binge.tube link to watch.

positive.prompt: Recommend some werewolf romance short dramas on BingeTube.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls recommend_shows (likes "werewolf romance", optionally the Werewolf & Fantasy genre) and returns several werewolf series with premises and binge.tube links.

positive.prompt: Tell me about the BingeTube show 'After He Played Dead, I Married the Don'.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_show with the title and describes the series (premise, genres, 77 episodes), with a link to watch and a few related series.

positive.prompt: What are the most watched short dramas on BingeTube right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls top_shows and lists the series viewers watched most in the last 30 days, with binge.tube links.

positive.prompt: What are the most watched revenge dramas on BingeTube this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls top_shows with genre "Revenge" and lists the most watched revenge series with episode counts and binge.tube links.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in London tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: Answers without calling any BingeTube tool.

negative.prompt: Write a Python function that reverses a string.
negative.expected_behavior: Writes the code without calling any BingeTube tool.

negative.description: Another service named by the person
negative.prompt: Recommend a good movie to watch on Netflix tonight.
negative.expected_behavior: Recommends Netflix movies without calling any BingeTube tool.

publication.release_notes: Search BingeTube's short drama catalog, get recommendations for a mood or trope, look up one series and see what's most watched, with links to watch on binge.tube.
